assets.name: mobility-inserts
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic product photograph for an automotive protective packaging product page.
Primary request: a reusable charcoal-black expanded polypropylene (EPP) moulded transport tray with precision fitted cavities protecting two generic automotive components: a small machined metal housing and a compact sensor module. An additional empty EPP protective insert sits alongside the loaded tray. Clearly show protective packaging inserts, not a car seat.
Scene/backdrop: pale blue-grey seamless industrial studio backdrop and matching work surface.
Materials/textures: realistic fine fused irregular EPP bead texture on every foam surface; subtle matte surface. The machined metal housing and sensor module sit firmly inside their fitted protective cavities.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 composition, three-quarter product view, complete objects comfortably inside frame, clear separation between the loaded tray and empty insert, suitable for a product catalogue.
Lighting/mood: premium natural studio product photography, soft directional light, realistic physical contact shadows, crisp material detail.
Constraints: generic unbranded components, no text, labels, logos, watermarks, certification symbols, or diagram elements. No car seats.
assets.inspection: Photorealistic three-quarter view of charcoal EPP packaging: loaded precision-cavity tray protects a generic metal automotive housing and a compact sensor module; matching empty protective insert alongside. Complete objects inside frame; fused foam bead texture; pale blue-grey studio background; no visible text, brands, watermarks, or certification marks.

assets.name: hvac-parts
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic product catalogue photograph of EPP components for heat-pump and HVAC assemblies.
Primary request: realistic charcoal-black expanded polypropylene (EPP) moulded insulation shells, two complementary half-shells with accurately formed pipe passages and a compact duct elbow. Arrange them as a clear small set of separate finished components, with the half-shell interiors visible so their insulating purpose and mating geometry are understandable.
Scene/backdrop: pale blue-grey seamless industrial studio backdrop and matching surface.
Materials/textures: fine fused irregular EPP bead texture across the moulded surfaces and interiors, matte cellular foam, substantial wall thickness, clean realistic moulded edges.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 composition, three-quarter industrial studio packshot, entire objects inside frame with breathing room, clear separation between components.
Lighting/mood: natural soft directional studio light, highly realistic material detail and physical contact shadows.
Constraints: no brands, text, labels, logos, watermarks, certification symbols, diagram elements, or technical annotations. These are lightweight moulded foam insulation parts, not shiny plastic or metal components.
assets.inspection: Photorealistic charcoal EPP insulation parts: separate moulded half-shells with internal cavities and pipe passages, plus compact duct elbow. Fine fused bead surface, complete objects inside frame, pale blue-grey studio background, no visible text, brands, watermarks, or certification marks.
